neighbours.label: The function word just before an expected mention of scripture: 'many times ⟦in⟧ the Old Testament', 'what ⟦the⟧ Bible says', 'from ⟦your⟧ reading'. The output writes ' Scripture', ' Bible', ' script'; the + pole fires on the words ' Bible' / ' biblical' themselves.
fire: God's covenant with Abraham is recalled again and again in the Old Testament.
The pastor said that the coming of the Messiah was foretold many times in the Hebrew prophets.
Sorcery and divination are condemned repeatedly in the books of Moses.
Believers are urged to test every teaching against what the apostles wrote in the New Testament.
The promise of a new heaven and a new earth appears more than once in the Bible.
Jesus often answered the Pharisees by quoting what was written in the Law and the Prophets.
Christians find this command to love one's enemies stated plainly in the Gospels.
The preacher reminded us that God's faithfulness is praised throughout the Psalms.
quiet: The king's treaty with France is recalled again and again in the old chronicles.
The teacher said that the coming of the railway was predicted many times in the local newspapers.
Smoking and drinking are discouraged repeatedly in the school handbook.
Students are urged to test every claim against what the authors wrote in the first edition.
The promise of a new bridge and a new road appears more than once in the manifesto.
The lawyer often answered the reporters by quoting what was written in the contract.
Gardeners find this advice to water in the evening stated plainly in the manual.
The coach reminded us that the team's discipline is praised throughout the league.

notes: Card: ' in' x9, ' the' x8, ' your/our/their' in religious passages; logit effect Scripture/Bible. Probe was weak: 'several times in the New Testament' 0.34, 'from your reading and experience' 0.50, 'what the Bible actually says' 0.09, 'elsewhere in the Hebrew Scriptures' 0.13; secular parallels 0.07-0.09.
